# Are your lien deadlines still open?

> Free calculator for the preliminary notice and lien filing deadlines a subcontractor or supplier faces in California, Texas, Florida, Arizona, and Washington. Enter your first and last day on the job; see both dates, weekend flags, and days left. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
